meta.question: can we discern unification by screening published claims?

criteria.one_F: one map (or one group + RG) from a finite knob set
criteria.gauge3: α_em, α_s, sin²θ_W (or g, g', g_s) meet at one scale
criteria.gravity: G_N / Planck is an output of the same F, not an input leftover
criteria.vacuum: ρ_Λ / Λ is an output of the same F, not dropped
criteria.falsifiable: a finite experiment could kill it
criteria.not_killed: that experiment has not already killed it

claims.name: SM running (no extra stuff)

checks.falsifiable: yes — they either meet or they do not

claims.note: Baseline. The Standard Model does not unify the couplings.

claims.name: Georgi–Glashow SU(5)
claims.note: The original GUT. Publicly dead in its minimal form.

claims.name: MSSM / SUSY SU(5) or SO(10)

checks.falsifiable: yes — proton decay, superpartners, Higgs mass

claims.note: Best-known 3-gauge program still standing. Does not output G_N or Λ.

checks.one_F: partial unification, then a further step
checks.gauge3: not a single meeting of all three at one shot
checks.falsifiable: yes — extra gauge bosons, proton decay in embeddings

claims.name: Heterotic / type-II string landscape

checks.gauge3: some vacua can be arranged to meet
checks.gravity: G_N exists in the framework, not a unique output
checks.vacuum: Λ is a vacuum-selection problem, not a prediction
checks.falsifiable: yes in principle; unique numbers are not

claims.note: Has gravity in the story. Does not hand you one F to the observed leftovers.

claims.name: Asymptotic safety (gravity)

checks.gravity: gravity is the object; G_N runs, not derived as a meet
checks.falsifiable: yes — fixed-point existence, collider / cosmology bounds

claims.note: A gravity UV story. Not four-force unification.

claims.name: Lisi E8

checks.one_F: claimed E8 embedding of SM + gravity
checks.gauge3: not a demonstrated 3-meet from a working rep
checks.gravity: claimed, not accepted as a working output

claims.note: A published claim. Screened. Does not pass.

claims.name: Loop quantum gravity / causal sets

checks.one_F: no F to the three couplings
checks.gravity: quantum geometry; not G_N as a derived coupling meet
checks.falsifiable: yes — area spectrum, cosmology, Lorentz tests

claims.note: Quantum geometry, not a four-force unifier.

claims.name: This repo's reconstructed R / SFE knobs

checks.falsifiable: yes — lock-R, holdout F, width control
checks.not_killed: F already killed on this vector

claims.note: Screened the same way. Score is not F. Official Cosmo 16 is a different catalog.

claims.name: CosmoEvolution 3D / Domain Architect (public app)

checks.one_F: core equation is private / trade secret
checks.gauge3: app predicts couplings should NOT meet; a miss is not a 3-meet
checks.gravity: claimed via Planck spectral gap (order of magnitude)
checks.vacuum: claimed via domain web tension (order of magnitude)
checks.falsifiable: yes — manifold λ1/λ2, neutrino sum, Koide deviation
checks.not_killed: manifold sweep already failed for every known exact-spectrum topology

claims.note: Official 16 is in docs/COSMO-SIXTEEN.md. UI 16/16 is not a DA pass. F is not public.

discernment: Yes. Gauge-coupling meeting (gauge3) is a real, fail-able claim. Four-force unification with gravity and vacuum in the same F (nature4) is a stricter claim. Nothing on this list passes nature4. MSSM-class GUTs stay open as gauge3. Minimal SU(5) and the SM miss. That is discernment. It is not a unifier in this repo.
